Money Flow

Offline-first personal finance tracking, on your device.

In development

Money Flow is an offline-first personal finance tracker for Android. It records income and expense transactions across multiple account types, organizes them into categories, and helps you set budgets, track savings goals, monitor investments, and manage loans and EMIs. All data is stored locally in a SQLite database on your device. There is no login or account system, and no server that your financial data is sent to.

Features

Transactions

Record income and expense transactions, with filtering and searching to find what you're looking for.

Accounts

Track multiple account types, including savings, wallet, credit card, investment, and business accounts.

Categories

Organize transactions into categories, and archive categories you no longer use.

Budgets

Set spending budgets and track your progress against them.

Savings Goals

Create savings goals and track contributions toward them over time.

Investments

Track investment holdings alongside your other accounts.

Loans and EMI Tracking

Track loans and debts, including equated monthly installment (EMI) calculations.

Reports and Charts

View reports and charts that summarize your accounts, spending, and budgets.

CSV Import and Export

Import transactions from a CSV or XLSX template, and export your transaction data to CSV.

Local Backup and Restore

Create a local JSON backup and restore from a backup file. No cloud account is required.

PIN and Biometric App Lock

Optionally lock the app with a PIN or biometric unlock. Sensitive actions like resetting or restoring data require re-authentication.

Currency and Theme Customization

Choose from multiple currencies, and switch between light, dark, or system theme.
